meta.note: expected values come from an independent Python oracle (zoneinfo), checked against hand-worked literals; epoch seconds are compared, never formatted strings

deadlines.name: H2 2 calendar days before Monday noon
H3 2 working days (Mon-Fri) before Monday noon skips the weekend
H4 1 working day before Monday noon is the Friday
H5 3 days, Saturday closed only, before Monday
H6 1 week ignores the open-days mask
H7 1 week across the DST end keeps the wall clock
H8 2 days across the DST end keeps the wall clock
H9a 24 hours across the DST end is elapsed time
H9b 36 hours across the DST end is elapsed time
H10a 48 hours across the DST start is elapsed time
H10b 60 hours across the DST start is elapsed time
H11 2 days across the DST start keeps the wall clock
H12 8 working hours before Monday 06:00 skip the closed weekend
H14 negative value is no deadline
H15 unknown unit is no deadline
H16 upper-case unit is read case-insensitively
H17 an empty mask means every day is open
H18 bits above Sunday are ignored (255 == 127)
H19 null value is no deadline
H20 null unit is no deadline

actions.name: A1 change one second before X is open
A1 change exactly AT X is open
A1 change one second after X is locked by the cancellation deadline
A2 cancel exactly AT X is open
A2 cancel one second after X is locked
A3 add exactly AT C is open (X is irrelevant to add)
A3 add one second after C is locked
A3 add is still open after X
A10 between X and C: change locked, add open
A4 change after C with no X is locked by the order cutoff
A4 cancel after C with no X stays open until the serving time
A4 cancel after the serving time is locked
A5 change with no C is closed by X
A5 add with no C is open until the serving time
A6 X equals C: the reason is the cancellation deadline
A7 nothing configured, at the serving time
A7 nothing configured, after the serving time
A8 moving the order to a slot whose cutoff has passed
A8 moving to a slot whose cutoff is still open
A9 moving to a slot already in the past, nothing configured
A11 stored slot locked by X, new slot open: refused
A12 cancel, 2 working days, open on Thursday noon
A12 cancel, 2 working days, locked on Thursday noon + 1 s

locks.name: L2 order CONFIRMED may still be changed (operator D4 = allow)
L5 no anchor at all fails closed
L6 draft cancel is always allowed even after the serving time
L7 draft change ignores the cancellation deadline
L8 draft change still obeys the order cutoff of the serving time
L9 draft change to a new slot is judged on the new slot
L10 billed does not block ADD
